title: A message's 'exclude' writes its 'policy.exclude' as an interaction's does.
why: behavioural spec 'exclude': valid on a message ('message' and its chain) as on an interaction, appending to the document's 'policy.exclude' in call order. A message has a variant space as an interaction does (ADR 0067), so a combination its provider cannot produce is excluded the same way.

exclude.reason: the shop always writes a note
the shop always writes a note
